designSystem: Crosslinks Recruitment Portal 2026 UI Design System

fontFamilies.sans: "Plus Jakarta Sans", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

componentStyles.navbar: Fixed floating capsule with logo on left (swaps to crosslinks/recruitments-2026 address bar on mobile scroll) and theme toggle on right.

buttons.ctaAlumniStyle: h-11 sm:h-12 px-7 sm:px-8 inline-flex items-center justify-center rounded-full border border-accent/80 text-accent bg-accent/5 backdrop-blur-sm text-sm sm:text-base font-semibold transition-all duration-300 hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground hover:border-accent cursor-pointer whitespace-nowrap

cards.glassCard: background-color: var(--card); backdrop-filter: blur(24px); border: 1.5px solid var(--border); shadow-md hover:border-accent hover:shadow-xl
cards.departmentCard: group relative flex flex-col justify-between p-6 rounded-2xl border-border/80 bg-card hover:bg-muted/50 hover:border-accent/60 shadow-md hover:shadow-xl hover:shadow-accent/10

componentStyles.stepper: Sleek segmented capsule tab bar with animated sliding pill highlight (layoutId="active-step-capsule") and step numbers (01. / 02.) vertically aligned.
componentStyles.cursorBlob: Compact white follower outer circle ring (32px / 36px) with glowing arrow icon on data-hover-arrow and inner purple/accent precision dot.
